$comment: French words for the API codes, shared by the web (src/app/shared/listing/labels.fr.ts and its
neighbours) and the Android app (mobile/, which generates Dart from this file).
enums: one object per generated enum, named as in openapi.json, every value once. Both clients
fail to compile when a value is missing, and their tests fail on a value that no longer exists.
Key order is display order where one matters (FeatureCategory, DamageFilter).
Values come from the API, words from here: the agreed split, docs/mobile-plan.md section 2.
departements: the French départements by code (01 … 95, 2A, 2B, 971 … 976), for the dealer directory.
validation: the forms' messages, by validator key; {length}, {min} and {max} are filled in.
messages: what the client says when the API gives no code to word, and the wait after a throttle.
notices: sentences shown as they are; links are written [words](/path), the site’s paths.
